description:
## Goal

A completed dispatch already names a plan-owned `OutcomeId`. Route that identity directly to the target each artifact owns, without rebuilding `outcome -> body_id -> target` through linear scans or adding a second body-id authority.

## Proven current state

`PatternDispatchPlan::body_id` linearly finds the outcome entry; `ExecutableDispatch::clause_index` linearly finds a body id; interpreter dispatch-call execution and native dispatch lowering linearly find a `DispatchCallArm`; native receive linearly finds an outcome edge. These answers are all derived from the same completed selection, but each consumer reconstructs it.

`PatternBodyId` is caller-owned and only guaranteed strictly increasing, not dense. It must never become a raw vector index or a hidden dense-map assumption. `OutcomeId` is the graph-owned dense identity and is the only suitable table coordinate.

## Design

- `PatternDispatchPlan` exposes its outcome payload by `OutcomeId` in O(1), with construction validating the graph/outcome correspondence.
- Each artifact that owns a target for an outcome stores one outcome-indexed target-slot table. A deliberately absent target is explicit, rather than a failed lookup or a synthesized fallback.
- Entry dispatch, inline dispatch calls, native lowering, and native receive consume that owner table. `PatternBodyId` remains opaque routing data at the source/body boundary; no reverse body-id map or generic copied cache is introduced.
- Delete every production linear outcome/body/arm target lookup replaced by this route. Test-only search helpers may remain only where their purpose is independently stated.

## TDD / signal

First pin a source plan with sparse monotonic body ids and verify its dense outcomes route each selected outcome to the right payload. Then pin entry dispatch, an inline `case` dispatch call, and receive through their existing three-door or focused native tests. The existing artifact source-order assertion stays: outcome routing must not make incidental vector order a semantic authority.

Equal product reproduction reuses the immutable shared plan and its artifact-owned slots; a target table is constructed only with its owning product, never during interpretation. No semantic output, canonical artifact, allocation pin, or census row may rise without an explained causal change.

## Documentation / deletion

Update pattern-matching and semantic-authorities to name `OutcomeId` as dispatch selection identity and each artifact target slot as its owner. Remove stale prose that says entry dispatch maps through `body_id` then `clause_index`.
title: OutcomeId routes directly to each artifact-owned target slot
